name: RE*start
source:
Roy Mustang arrives by the train to the East City after long absence. On the way to the military command he meets colonel Edward Elric and gets a crush on him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
阔别许久后，罗伊·马斯坦乘火车来到东都。前往军事司令部的途中，他遇见了爱德华·艾尔利克上校，并对他一见倾心。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
